commands.name: status
commands.summary: Who you are, your grant, your cursor, your claim and what needs you.

commands.name: describe
commands.summary: The full contract of one command (or the list of commands), generated from the registry.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: How to do one kind of work (a workflow), generated from the registry; no argument lists them.

commands.name: show
commands.summary: Read a ticket: the default view, some sections, everything, the log or a diff since an event.

commands.name: list
commands.summary: List tickets, newest first.

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Search ticket titles and sections.

commands.name: next
commands.summary: The ticket to work on next.

commands.name: inbox
commands.summary: Tickets handed over from peer workspaces.

commands.name: new
commands.summary: Create a ticket.

commands.name: claim
commands.summary: Claim a ticket, the next one, or take over another session's claim.

commands.name: release
commands.summary: Release your claim without a handoff.

commands.name: handoff
commands.summary: Write the current state (at most 2048 bytes) and release the claim.

commands.name: submit
commands.summary: Move the ticket to testing; every acceptance criterion needs evidence first.

commands.name: ask
commands.summary: Ask a person; works without a grant (unattended). Then orch wait.

commands.name: wait
commands.summary: Wait for an answer, an approval, a change request, a verdict or an invalidation (default 540 s).

commands.name: set
commands.summary: Set ticket fields: title, priority, size, labels, due, links, parent, blocked_by.

commands.name: section.set
commands.summary: Replace one section of the body with text from -m or --file.

commands.name: ac.add
commands.summary: Add an acceptance criterion.

commands.name: ac.edit
commands.summary: Change the text of an acceptance criterion.

commands.name: task.list
commands.summary: List the ticket's tasks with their state.

commands.name: task.next
commands.summary: The next task to do: its text, what it proves and its verify command.

commands.name: task.add
commands.summary: Add a task, optionally with a verify command and the criteria it proves.

commands.name: task.start
commands.summary: Take the lease on one task (parallel subagents use ORCH_SESSION=<parent>.<n>).

commands.name: task.done
commands.summary: Finish a task: --run runs its verify command and stores the receipt; prints the next task.

commands.name: task.skip
commands.summary: Skip a task, with a reason.

commands.name: task.block
commands.summary: Mark a task blocked, with a reason.

commands.name: task.reopen
commands.summary: Reopen a finished, skipped or blocked task.

commands.name: artifact.add
commands.summary: Store a file; works without a grant (unattended, never evidence). --ac and --task need a grant.

commands.name: artifact.replace
commands.summary: Replace a stored file; the name stays, the digest changes.

commands.name: artifact.list
commands.summary: List the ticket's artifacts.

commands.name: log
commands.summary: Add a note to the ticket log; works without a grant (unattended).

commands.name: apply
commands.summary: Apply a batch of operations atomically, from JSON (--file -).

commands.name: approve
commands.summary: Approve a gate (requirements, plan or code) with your signature.

commands.name: request_changes
commands.summary: Request changes on a gate, with a reason.

commands.name: verdict
commands.summary: Give the verify verdict: pass, or fail with a reason.

commands.name: answer
commands.summary: Answer a question with an option, text, or both.

commands.name: close
commands.summary: Close a ticket without finishing it.

commands.name: reopen
commands.summary: Reopen a done or closed ticket; raises every gate's generation.

commands.name: grant
commands.summary: Issue a standing grant for agents; the secret is printed once, on your terminal.

commands.name: grant.revoke
commands.summary: Revoke a grant; every session using it ends.

commands.name: member.add
commands.summary: Add a member with a role; their first device certificate comes with the invitation.

commands.name: member.remove
commands.summary: Remove a member; their claims are released.

commands.name: member.role
commands.summary: Change a member's role.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Create a workspace here: the genesis event, the workspace key and the instructions.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Check the logs, chains, projections and keys; reports, never changes.

commands.name: check
commands.summary: Check that the ticket files match their events (for a commit hook).

commands.name: instructions.sync
commands.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.orch.md and the skills to the installed version.

commands.name: import.v1
commands.summary: Import a v1 workspace: tickets, history as imported events, artifacts.

commands.name: addon.list
commands.summary: List the installed addons and whether each is enabled.

commands.name: addon.grant
commands.summary: Grant an addon its capabilities (owner only); also enables it.

commands.name: addon.disable
commands.summary: Disable an addon; its data stays.

commands.name: addon.purge
commands.summary: Delete an addon's data.
